families.name: Cross endpoint predicates through expansion continuation

vars.query: MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = 123 OR g.v = 123 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = $value OR g.v = $value RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.objectid = 'source' AND (s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99) RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s = g RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = g.v RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v <> g.v RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE NOT (s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99) RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE (s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99) AND (s.objectid = 'source' OR g.v = 2) RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (d)<-[:EndpointT]-(g)<-[:EndpointR*1..2]-(s) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c

variants.name: physical inbound expansion followed by hop

vars.query: MATCH (g)<-[:EndpointR*1..2]-(s)-[:EndpointP]->(d) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*0..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d)-[:EndpointU]->(e) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (prefix)-[:EndpointR]->(s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s:EndpointRoot) WHERE s.objectid = 'source' WITH s, 'wanted' AS wanted MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.objectid = wanted OR g.objectid = wanted RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH p = (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN p
UNWIND [1,1] AS duplicate WITH duplicate MATCH p = (s:EndpointRoot)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.objectid = 'source' AND (s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99) RETURN p
MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]-(d:EndpointEnd) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (d:EndpointEnd) WITH d MATCH (s)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[:EndpointT]->(d) WHERE s.v = 99 OR g.v = 99 RETURN count(*) AS c
MATCH (s:EndpointRoot)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[t:EndpointT]->(d:EndpointEnd) WHERE s.objectid = 'source' AND t.enabled = true AND (s.v = $value OR g.v = $value) SET d.selected = true
MATCH (s:EndpointRoot)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[t:EndpointT]->(d:EndpointEnd) WHERE s.objectid = 'source' AND t.enabled = true AND (s.v = $value OR g.v = $value) SET t.selected = true

MATCH (s:EndpointRoot)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[t:EndpointT]->(d:EndpointEnd) WHERE s.objectid = 'source' AND t.enabled = true AND (s.v = $value OR g.v = $value) SET d.selected = true, t.selected = true

MATCH (s:EndpointRoot)-[:EndpointR*1..2]->(g)-[t:EndpointT]->(d:EndpointEnd) WHERE s.objectid = 'source' AND t.enabled = true AND (s.v = $value OR g.v = $value) SET d.selected = true, t.selected = true
